mapper.sql: select d.*, coalesce(s.backup_count, 0) backup_count, s.latest_event from visible_database_catalog d left join ( select database_id, count(*) backup_count, max(event_time) latest_event from visible_backup_record group by database_id ) s on s.database_id = d.id
mapper.select: where lower(d.name) like lower(#{pattern}) order by d.name

where.if: (lower(d.name) like lower(#{pattern}) escape '!' or lower(coalesce(d.dbid, '')) like lower(#{pattern}) escape '!' or lower(coalesce(d.asset_external_id, '')) like lower(#{pattern}) escape '!' or lower(coalesce(d.tag, '')) like lower(#{pattern}) escape '!' or lower(coalesce(d.subsystem, '')) like lower(#{pattern}) escape '!' or lower(coalesce(d.developer, '')) like lower(#{pattern}) escape '!' or lower(coalesce(d.dba, '')) like lower(#{pattern}) escape '!' or lower(coalesce(d.service_unit, '')) like lower(#{pattern}) escape '!')
and exists (select 1 from visible_backup_record b where b.database_id = d.id)
and not exists (select 1 from visible_backup_record b where b.database_id = d.id)

mapper.select: select distinct framework from visible_database_catalog where framework is not null and framework != '' order by framework
select d.*, 0 backup_count, null latest_event from visible_database_catalog d where d.active = true order by d.id
select id from database_catalog where name = #{name}
select id from database_catalog where name = #{name} and is_demo = true and asset_external_id is null
mapper.insert: insert into database_catalog(name, monitor_from, monitor_from_auto) values(#{name}, #{monitorFrom}, #{monitorFromAuto}) on conflict do nothing
insert into database_catalog(name, monitor_from, monitor_from_auto, is_demo) values(#{name}, #{monitorFrom}, false, true) on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update database_catalog set dbid = #{metadata.dbid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, tag = #{metadata.tag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, lifecycle_status = #{metadata.lifecycleStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, security_tier = #{metadata.securityTier,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, framework = #{metadata.framework,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, db_version = #{metadata.dbVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, subsystem = #{metadata.subsystem,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, developer = #{metadata.developer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, dba = #{metadata.dba,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, service_unit = #{metadata.serviceUnit,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, created_on = #{metadata.createdOn,jdbcType=DATE} where id = #{id}

update database_catalog set asset_external_id = #{asset.externalId}, active = true, is_demo = false, dbid = coalesce(#{asset.metadata.dbid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, dbid), tag = coalesce(#{asset.metadata.tag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, tag), lifecycle_status = coalesce(#{asset.metadata.lifecycleStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, lifecycle_status), security_tier = coalesce(#{asset.metadata.securityTier,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, security_tier), framework = coalesce(#{asset.metadata.framework,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, framework), db_version = coalesce(#{asset.metadata.dbVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, db_version), subsystem = coalesce(#{asset.metadata.subsystem,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, subsystem), developer = coalesce(#{asset.metadata.developer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, developer), dba = coalesce(#{asset.metadata.dba,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, dba), service_unit = coalesce(#{asset.metadata.serviceUnit,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, service_unit), created_on = coalesce(#{asset.metadata.createdOn,jdbcType=DATE}, created_on) where name = #{asset.dbName} and (asset_external_id is null or asset_external_id = #{asset.externalId})
update database_catalog set monitor_from = #{monitorFrom}, monitor_from_auto = false where id = #{id} and name = #{name} and is_demo = true and asset_external_id is null
